elements.requirement: A controller is prohibited from transferring personal data to a country or territory outside the United Kingdom or to an international organisation unless the transfer falls within subsection (2).
elements.quote: A controller may not transfer personal data to— (a) a country or territory outside the United Kingdom, or (b) an international organisation, unless the transfer falls within subsection (2).

elements.requirement: A transfer of personal data falls within subsection (2) if it is a necessary and proportionate measure carried out for the purposes of the controller's statutory functions.
elements.quote: A transfer of personal data falls within this subsection if the transfer is a necessary and proportionate measure carried out— (a) for the purposes of the controller's statutory functions
